collections.title: Notepad++ 8.9.8.1 · Windows 98 GOP
collections.display: 1280 × 800 · Shizuku basic graphics driver · compatibility launcher · KVM
collections.result: Save, cold-boot reopen, keyboard editing and scoped clean exit verified
observations: The original Notepad++ 8.9.8.1 ran on the real Windows 98 GOP display.
The new file's actual 44 bytes and the original app and driver files were independently checked on disk.
The next boot reopened that file; different text was typed, saved as a new 39-byte file, and the app exited normally.
collections.scope: This accepted trial requires the dedicated compatibility launcher and scoped native field interpretation. Unassisted clean exit is not verified; the earlier failure is preserved. During the repeat trial, the save target was corrected and previous documents were restored and compared. A keypress is required at the DOS video prompt. GPU 3D acceleration and other modern apps remain in development.

collections.title: VLC 3.0.24 · real video output
collections.result: Changing video verified · full player interface failed
observations: Official VLC 3.0.24 displayed a test video on the real Windows 98 GOP screen.
Comparing only the video region verified yellow bar widths of 46, 73 and 99 pixels.
The Qt interface component failed to load. Clean exit and audible output were not verified.
collections.scope: Partial verification of actual video output, not acceptance of a complete usable player. The run log was seen on screen, but its on-disk file is 0 bytes. Stopping the VM does not prove a clean app or Windows exit.

collections.title: VLC 3.0.24 · first startup failure
collections.result: Initial video and audio startup failures preserved
observations: The original VLC executable and compatibility components were installed and launched after a fresh Windows 98 GOP boot.
After dismissing the video trial's error dialog, the actual process returned 0. That is not successful playback.
After adding the official file logger plugin, partial video output was verified in a separate record.
collections.scope: The first startup errors and original captures are preserved. A working player window, video playback and audible output were not verified in this run. The audio process's exit was also not confirmed. Issues beyond the missing plugin may remain.

collections.title: Compatibility controls · real Windows 98
collections.result: Worker isolation, function binding and waits verified
observations: Worker data isolation and exit notifications were verified inside real Windows 98.
28 actual system-function binding controls and 28 address-based wait/wake controls passed.
All three control child processes exited normally, and the existing driver and editor files were preserved.
collections.scope: These are controls for features needed by apps. They do not prove Chromium GUI acceptance or browsing. Chromium, Legcord, LibreOffice and Steam running inside Windows 98 remain in development.

collections.platform: Real Microsoft Windows 98 SE · UEFI boot
collections.result: Real Qt GUI and changing video verified · clean exit failed
observations: VLC 3.0.24's actual menus, playback controls and changing test video were verified.
Clean exit failed with an RPCRT4 error. Audible output has not been verified.
collections.scope: Captured in real Windows 98 after a Qt diagnostic run. That diagnostic's effect is still being checked in a separate boot. The video is a 160 × 120 test AVI. This does not establish full app, audio or 3D acceleration acceptance. Exit code 0 after dismissing the error dialog is not a successful clean exit.
